gigsim.personalisation: heuristic fallback (GIGSIM_LLM_DISABLED=1) to save Groq quota; deterministic

config_snapshot.llm_cache: data/cache/evals/llm (hits replay stored token counts; latency only from cold runs)

gold: gold.relevant_evidence_ids (llm_label_v1, qwen/qwen3.8-27b; past proposals not in the label catalogue)
latency_note: retrieval only, per job, warm query-embedding cache (all variants alike); embedding one job text cold took 0.0004s on average (CPU, batched), not included
best_variant_rule: highest Recall@5 (tie: nDCG@10) on llm_sample, the jobs every LLM variant covered

skipped.v6_contextual: not run: needs one LLM call per chunk (1410 chunks over 3 personas, each sending the whole source document) on openai/gpt-oss-20b, which exceeds the Groq free-tier daily token quota (200k TPD per model) shared with the other evals. Run with --include-v6 when quota allows.
